acceptance: every layer declared in config has a directory that exists, and every one of those directories except the frozen layer's holds a README.md
the mechanism list is non-empty, or acknowledgedEmptyMechanisms is set on purpose
every mechanism in the list names a doc that exists
scripts/docs-check.py exits zero on the project
the pre-push hook is wired and a push that violates a declared code-doc pair is actually rejected — installed is not the same as working
no document sits under two declared layer roots
the project's agent-instruction file follows the content rules (no architecture overview, not auto-generated, ~150-200 lines); only the line cap is machine-checked, the rest is a human read
surfaceRules.paths names an instruction file that exists, and the seeded worked example is gone once a real mechanism exists
every layer the project actually has is declared, the frozen one included, and none is split across two directories
no docs directory holds a single document, and every directory that survives has a reason a reader can state
every technical claim in a mechanism doc was verified against the shipped code before writing — no fluent description of behaviour the code does not actually have
a mechanism with real surface is documented at the house norm (tables, cross-links to specs/backlog, inline caveats about known limits), not shipped as a bare four-section skeleton
